460.title: Error correction (editing) — ache e corrija o erro (argumentação)
460.note: Um erro por frase. Corrija e diga por quê.

items.q: The questions are simple, because the habit is teachable.

items.q: Because the discipline is cultural, so it spreads.
items.a: Because the discipline is cultural, it spreads. (não juntar 'because' e 'so')

items.q: Tax shapes pricing, therefore it is strategic, because of this.

items.q: We ask early so surprises are expensive.

items.q: Withholding affects the price therefore it matters.

items.q: The habit is simple, so therefore it becomes cultural.
